decision.title: XSLT conformance sweep by root-cause clusters (packet 4.23)
decision.summary: The XSLT sweep fixes failures by root-cause clusters, among them enclosing modes, xsl:copy of array and map JNodes, constructor error codes, static variable consistency and fn:current-output-uri scoping, raising XT40 from 12,081 to 12,156 passes.

body.p: , after , , , , , , , , . Verified as asks: the debug and debug-gcc presets, the touched unit tests (xslt, construct, xdm, jnode, the drivers, cli), clang-tidy, the call-cycle check, the book examples (), and the whole XT40 suite with the release driver after each change, case by case. XT40 12,081 to 12,156 passed (130 to 120 wrong error), 437 to 362 failed, 0 errors, no case lost (74 failures and 11 wrong errors to passes, function-1018 from failure to wrong error); gate rate 94.9 % to 95.7 %. QT4: the 2,939 assert-xml cases, fn-jkey, fn-jtree, fn-jvalue and prod-MapConstructor give the same outcomes in XP40 and XQ40.

item.p: Clusters at the start (whole run at 72119c1; 437 failures and 130 wrong errors, of which 's 57 newest-draft cases are left as they are), by root cause: assert-xml with whitespace around the result (17); enclosing modes (8); xsl:copy of JNodes (12); fn:current-output-uri (9); XSLT codes of constructor errors, XTDE0430/0440/0835/0865 (11); static variables (XTSE3450, 5) and attributes 9.2 and 9.6 forbid (XTSE0020, 3); initial-mode eligibility (XTDE0045, 5); XTSE0545 for name lists and types (2); xsl:sequence and xsl:select as= and xsl:select's content (8); fn:stream-available (6); the driver's #absent and package versions (4); and a long tail of singletons.

Fixes, one mechanism each: assert-xml drops whitespace around a result that is one document's worth of XML, as it did for the expected text (the catalog canonicalizes; XML 1.0 [27] Misc); enclosing modes (6.9.6) as the default mode of their rules, XTSE4015, XTSE4020, XTSE4025; XTSE0545 compares use-accumulators as sets of names and as/typed as types (identical: each a subtype of the other, as 3.4.5.3); XTDE0045 by 2.4.3's eligibility (an xsl:stylesheet exposes its modes, 3.5); xsl:copy of an Array or Map JNode (11.9.1.2) evaluates its content and builds the array or map (as xsl:array, xsl:map duplicates use-last), J1 a parentless JNode with J0's jkey (internal sxml_json_node_make_keyed_root, src/xdm_internal.h; xdm.h is not changed); fn:jkey and 's { E } rule test the key, not the parent; xsl:array-member replaces JNodes by their jvalues (22.1, one level); XSLT element construction raises XTDE0440 for a default namespace node on an element in no namespace and XTDE0430 for XQDY0102 (5.7.1), and xsl:element/xsl:attribute XTDE0835/XTDE0865 for the xmlns namespace (11.2.2, 11.3); static variables are checked for consistency with an earlier one of lower precedence (9.6, XTSE3450) and the higher one stays in scope; fn:current-output-uri is cleared in stylesheet functions, globals and patterns by a scope entry (sxml_xpath_lowerer_clear_output_uri, 's mechanism) and current-output-uri#0 captures its value (26.3.1, PR 2274); fn:stream-available answers as fn:doc-available (18.2 constrains only a true result); xsl:sequence/xsl:select as= coerce (10.4.1, 10.4.2); XTSE0010 for xsl:if then= with content (8.1 gives no code) and for an element other than xsl:fallback in xsl:select; the XSLT driver reads output file="#absent" as no base output URI and prefers a package file's own package-version to the catalog's.

The draft wins (; recorded, not changed): beside 's 57, XTSE3185 for xsl:when, xsl:otherwise and xsl:map-entry with select and content (choose-4502/-4503, maps-008, error-3280a: the suite says XTSE0010/XTSE3280); XPTY0004 for XPTY0019/XPTY0020 (5); exact numeric comparison of xs:double and xs:decimal (F&O 4.0, op:numeric-equal; sx-gc-eq-016/-020/-021/-116/-120/-121); xsl:sequence as= (function-1018).
Suite errors: package-location-001 to -005 name files the suite does not have and assert @q where the stylesheet writes @p.

Tried and not kept: XSLT without XPath's predeclared prefixes (xs, fn, map, array, math, err, xsi; 3.6.1 and 5.3.1 give only the applicable static namespaces and xml) passes namespace-6202 and loses nothing in XT40, but four unit-test files, the README's examples and the book's page.xsl rely on xs: and map: undeclared; a change of user behaviour for one case, left as a deviation for a later decision.

Left, with causes: a template applied from a stylesheet function still sees the current output URI (current-output-uri-008: the clearing is lexical); fn:stream-available on documents well-formed only to the first start tag (-004, -005); captured groups through called templates (analyze-string-078 to -081, : lexical; an implicit tunnel parameter would carry them); the per-item copies of a Sequence JNode (copy-5405, -5501, -5502); fn:apply-templates (5, a re-entrant call from a function, ); XSLT codes for absent-focus errors in fn:key/unparsed-entity-* (XTDE1270/1370/1380) and casting failures in coercions (FORG0001 for XTTE0570/0590/0505); XPath prolog declarations in xsl:select (seqtor-143/-144, XPath 4.0); assert-xml expected texts with indentation (sf-snapshot, 9); xml-version-007, namespace-2606, docbook-004, document-4066, fn-transform-27/-82e/ -94 (causes as and give them).
